title: Macro 3×3 Pad
tagline: Programmable shortcut pads with onboard EEPROM storage.
summary: A compact USB HID keypad family that persists custom key bindings directly to onboard EEPROM so no background software ever has to stay running.
whatItSolves: Commercial macro pads demand bloated always-on background suites and cloud logins. Eggman Macro saves bindings straight onto the microcontroller chip.
highlights: Configure once via serial utility, then close forever
Shortcuts travel with the pad across Windows, Linux, and macOS
Signed firmware builds published on releases.eggmanstudios.me

detailPage.headline: Nine keys. Zero background bloatware.
paragraphs: Commercial macro pads lock basic shortcuts behind 500 MB background suites and cloud accounts—and lose your bindings on any other machine.
Eggman Macro writes key bindings directly into onboard EEPROM memory and behaves as a driverless USB keyboard everywhere.

bullets.text: Shortcuts persist across reboots and computers with zero background daemons.
From 4-key strips and 3×3 pads to 16-key grids and multi-encoder editing decks.
Verify SHA-256 checksums and fetch signed firmware via ReleaseHub.

stepsSection.title: Set up in under two minutes.
stepsSection.subtitle: Plug in over USB, assign your bindings once, and carry your workflow anywhere.

steps.title: Plug in via USB
steps.description: Enumerates immediately as a standard HID keyboard with zero custom kernel drivers.

steps.title: Assign key bindings
steps.description: Use the lightweight serial configurator to write your shortcuts to onboard EEPROM.

steps.title: Unplug & use anywhere
steps.description: Close the utility forever; bindings stay on the chip across every OS.
